sites.name: Sharda Peeth ruins
sites.what: Historic temple and learning-centre ruins at Sharda in the Neelum Valley, listed among AJK tourism destinations. Smartraveller: Reconsider your need to travel to Pakistan overall; foreign nationals may not travel within 15 km of the Kashmir Line of Control (read 4 November 2026). Sharda lies in the Neelum Valley near the Line of Control; check the 15 km rule before going.

lore.text: Local legend says Sharda was one of the great seats of the goddess Saraswati and of the Sharada script.
